name: nomadsf
description: NomadSF Studio: Salesforce developer workbench for the NomadSF app, browser extension and IDEs

scripts.build: yarn --cwd packages/ui build && yarn --cwd apps/extension build && yarn --cwd apps/vscode build
scripts.test: yarn --cwd packages/core test && yarn --cwd apps/vscode test
scripts.typecheck: yarn --cwd packages/core typecheck && yarn --cwd packages/ui typecheck && yarn --cwd apps/extension typecheck && yarn --cwd apps/vscode typecheck
